raw.title: Robotics Software Engineer Intern – Swarm Systems (m/f/d)
raw.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team building autonomous robotic systems
  • Contribute to software that is tested on real robotic platforms and in the field
  • Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technologies in robotics, autonomy, and multi-agent systems
  • Work closely with experienced robotics and embedded engineers
  • Take ownership of meaningful technical projects while receiving guidance from the team
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and a collaborative engineering culture


Your mission

Join our robotics team working on autonomous systems that operate as coordinated, distributed agents in real-world environments. 

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the development and validation of our multi-UAV system, with a particular focus on software tooling, simulation, and system observability. 

Depending on your background and the project, you may also contribute to areas such as SLAM, navigation, perception, planning, or multi-agent coordination. This is a hands-on internship where you will develop and test software, work with real robotic systems, and see how your work performs beyond simulation. 

  • Develop data-driven dashboards and tools to monitor, analyze, and visualize system performance
  • Extend our simulation framework with KPIs, automated scenarios, and evaluation workflows
  • Analyze simulation and field-test data to identify issues and opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to the core robotics stack in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or mission execution
  • Collaborate closely with robotics, simulation, embedded, and domain experts
  • Gain practical experience developing and validating software for complex autonomous systems


Your profile

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Autonomous Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Good programming skills in C++, ideally modern C++ (17/20)
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering
  • Basic understanding of robotics concepts such as coordinate frames, sensor data, estimation, planning, or control
  • Comfortable working in Linux
  • Curious about complex roboticsystems and motivated to understand how things work beyond your individual component
  • Able to work independently on a defined technical problem while actively seeking feedback when needed
  • Genuine interest in autonomous systems, robotics, and defense technology


Nice to have

You do not need to bring all of these — experience from university projects, research, student teams, personal projects, or previous internships counts. 

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2
  • Experience with real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups
  • Exposure to SLAM, navigation, computer vision, estimation, filtering, planning, or control
  • Interest or experience in multi-agent systems, swarming, or distributed robotics
  • Experience working with LiDAR or camera data
  • Exposure to PX4 or ArduPilot
  • Experience with simulation frameworks such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or Unreal Engine
  • Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or networking
  • Exposure to machine learning methods


What else

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn
  • Structured and reliable way of working
  • Comfortable working in an environment where not every problem has a predefined solution
  • Collaborative and open to technical feedback
  • High ethical standards and disciplined workethic
  • Extra-curricular engineering projects, robotics competitions, research, or other technical achievements are a plus

The practical part 

  • Duration: 3–6 months, full-time
  • Eligibility: NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required

raw.title: ML Data Engineer (m/f/d) - Sensor Data & Pipelines
raw.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

This role owns the data foundation of our perception systems end-to-end — the layer that directly determines model performance in real-world environments. You'll set the technical direction for how we collect, curate, and continuously improve the datasets behind object detection, working as a senior technical partner to ML, perception, and robotics teams — turning raw, messy sensor data into reliable, production-grade systems at scale.

You will take full ownership of the ML data lifecycle — from architecture decisions on ingestion and pipelines, through labeling strategy and QA, to driving continuous, metrics-informed dataset improvement — and will be expected to bring judgment and prior experience to how this is done, not just execute a defined process.



What you'll do:

  • Architect and own scalable pipelines for ingesting, organizing, and preprocessing large volumes of time-series camera and multi-sensor data (RGB, IR, thermal, depth, IMU)
  • Drive the strategy behind our object detection datasets, ensuring quality, diversity, and statistical representativeness at scale
  • Design and operate active learning loops that connect model performance directly to data selection and improvement priorities
  • Own labeling workflows end-to-end — tooling decisions, QA methodology, consistency standards, and coordination of annotation efforts
  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to diagnose model weaknesses, bias, and drift, and translate findings into concrete dataset strategy
  • Plan and lead data collection campaigns (field recordings, drone/video capture) to close gaps with high-value real-world data
  • Build internal tools and dashboards that give the org visibility into dataset quality, distribution, and performance gaps


Your profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and data processing frameworks (Pandas, NumPy, vectorized operations, multiprocessing)
  • Proven track record building and owning ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale video and sensor datasets in production
  • Deep experience with data orchestration and lifecycle management for ML/computer vision workflows, including dataset versioning and reproducibility
  • Strong command of object detection pipelines (Detectron2, MMDetection, COCO format, bounding-box standards)
  • Demonstrated experience designing active learning, uncertainty sampling, or semi-supervised dataset workflows
  • Deep familiarity with data annotation platforms (CVAT, Label Studio) and building automated QA/consistency checks
  • Strong grasp of evaluation metrics for object detection (IoU, mAP, precision-recall curves, class-wise metrics)
  • Comfortable owning decisions around databases (SQL/NoSQL), file systems, and large-scale image, video, and sensor dataset management
  • Track record of working cross-functionally and influencing perception, deployment, robotics, and data infrastructure teams
  • Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus


Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud storage and MLOps tools (AWS S3, MinIO, ClearML, MLFlow, Weights & Biases).
  • Familiarity with ROS / robotics data formats (bag files, TF trees, sensor_msgs), Docker, or embedded ML workflows.
  • Prior work with robotics, drones, or multi-sensor perception systems, including IR, LiDAR, radar, or audio datasets.


What else

  • Outside-the-box creativity with a blend of conceptual and systematic design thinking.
  • High intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Structured, methodical, and reliable execution, even under uncertainty.
  • Humble, collaborative, and mission-driven — values collective success over ego.
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic.
  • Extra-curricular achievements, leadership, or unique projects are a plus.
  • NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required.


Why us?

Join us to shape the future of AI-driven defense!

About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Project Director Schlüsselfertiger Wohnungsbau
description: Bis heute haben wir Immobilienprojekte im Gesamtvolumen von über einer 1 Milliarde Euro erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und Schaffung von bezahlbarem Wohnraum in Deutschland und Europa. Wir denken nicht wie klassische Immobilienentwickler – sondern wie Unternehmer: mit industrieller Haltung, Effizienzfokus und klarer Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen. Unsere Projekte entstehen durch tiefes operatives Engagement, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können. „Anders gebaut, um anders zu bauen.“ Unsere Struktur ist bewusst anders gewählt: vertikal integriert, eigentümergeführt, mit direkter Umsetzung durch interne Teams. Unser Ansatz In einer Zeit, in der viele technologiebasierte Produkte immer leistungsfähiger, zuverlässiger und gleichzeitig kostengünstiger werden, ist der Wohnungsbau in Deutschland in seinen Grundstrukturen seit Jahrzehnten nahezu unverändert geblieben. Wir setzen uns zum Ziel, dieses Paradigma grundlegend zu verändern: Durch die Entwicklung eines standardisierten, hochgradig optimierten Ansatzes wollen wir die Baukosten drastisch senken und gleichzeitig die Qualität und Verlässlichkeit des Wohnraums deutlich erhöhen. Kombiniert mit der zunehmenden Nachfrage nach bezahlbarem Wohnraum, wird dieses neue Modell den Weg für eine effizientere, nachhaltigere und sozialere Stadtentwicklung ebnen. Unser Unternehmen basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können. Durch die Eliminierung traditioneller, kostenintensiver Strukturen – sowohl intern in der Projektabwicklung als auch extern durch gezielte Einzelvergabe statt Generalunternehmermodelle – senken wir Kosten, beschleunigen Entscheidungsprozesse und erhöhen die Transparenz. Indem wir einen Großteil der Planungs- und Steuerungsleistungen intern abbilden, sichern wir nicht nur eine engere Qualitätskontrolle, sondern verkürzen auch die Rückkopplung zwischen Planung und Ausführung. Durch die konsequente Fokussierung auf einfache, bewährte Grundrisse, standardisierte Materialien und optimierte Bauprozesse schaffen wir robuste, hochwertige Produkte – effizient, zuverlässig und zukunftsfähig. Aufgaben Als Project Director übernehmen Sie die vollständige Verantwortung für die Realisierung unserer Wohnungsbauprojekte mit durchschnittlich rund 100 Wohneinheiten – vom ersten Konzept bis zur Schlüsselübergabe. Sie leiten das Projektteam, treffen Entscheidungen und stellen sicher, dass Qualität, Budget und Zeitplan nicht nur erreicht, sondern übertroffen werden. Sicherstellen, dass unser Projektentwicklungshandbuch umgesetzt und eingehalten wird. Ihre Vorschläge und Ideen zur Verbesserung unseres etablierten Systems sind willkommen und ausdrücklich erwünscht. Optimierung von Planungs- und Baukonzepten mit klarem Fokus auf Effizienz, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Geschwindigkeit. Koordination und Kontrolle der am Projekt beteiligten Architektur- und Ingenieurteams während der Planungsphase und Sicherstellung, dass unser Projektentwicklungshandbuch eingehalten wird. Führung von Verhandlungen und Ausarbeitung von Verträgen mit Partnern, Auftragnehmern und Dienstleistern, die an dem Projekt beteiligt sind auf Grundlage unseres Projektentwicklungshandbuchs . Überwachung der einzelnen Projektteams bei der Umsetzung der Bauverträge und Kontrolle der ausführenden Unternehmen (Einzelvergabe der Bauleistungen an Nachunternehmer) Koordination mit Behörden, Ingenieuren, Architekten, Nachunternehmer. Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium (Architektur, Bauwesen, Ingenieurwesen) oder vergleichbare Erfahrung. Hohe Leistungsfähigkeit, Durchsetzungsstärke, Unternehmergeist. Außergewöhnliche Problemlösungskompetenz – mit klarem Fokus auf Einfachheit, Schnelligkeit und Umsetzbarkeit. Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und Prioritäten richtig zu setzen, um den Anforderungen von Investoren und Unternehmen gerecht zu werden. Unkonventionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, etablierte Wege zu hinterfragen und mutig neue Methoden in der Wohnraumplanung und im Bauwesen auszuprobieren. Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, hohe Motivation und der starke Wunsch, zu lernen, zu wachsen und erfolgreich zu sein Kostenbewusstsein ist für Sie keine Pflicht, sondern ein Wettbewerb – Sie lieben es, Projekte unterhalb des Budgets und vor Ablauf der Frist abzuschließen. Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen Fundierte Kenntnisse in MS Office, Excel, CAD und PDF. Benefits Mitarbeit an Projekten, die echten Mehrwert für die Gesellschaft schaffen und das Leben vieler Menschen verbessern – bezahlbarer Wohnraum ist unser Beitrag für die Zukunft. Anerkennung als Game Changer am Immobilienmarkt – mit Kosteneinsparungen von über 30 % und bis zu 50 % kürzeren Bauzeiten im Vergleich zu traditionellen Marktteilnehmern. Arbeiten in einem leistungsorientierten und dynamischen Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Eigentümern und Investoren – schnelle Entscheidungsprozesse und maximale Umsetzungskraft zeichnen unser Unternehmen aus. Ein Unternehmen, in dem Ergebnisse zählen – Ihr Engagement wird geschätzt und belohnt. Offene Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. Langfristige Anstellung mit der Möglichkeit, Anteilseigner und Partner zu werden. Eine einzigartige Unternehmenskultur, die den Erfolg jedes Teammitglieds fördert, Unterstützung bietet und Ideen ernst nimmt. Gezielte Investition in Ihr Wachstum: Neben persönlichem Mentoring durch einen unserer Investoren und Gründer bieten wir Ihnen Zugang zu hochwertigem Wissen – von Büchern über Konferenzen bis hin zu Fachkursen, sowie die Möglichkeit, an strategischen Meetings und Veranstaltungen teilzunehmen. Dieses Umfeld verschafft Ihnen langfristig entscheidende Vorteile. Firmenwagen Ihrer Wahl. Vergütung: Ihre Vergütung (Festgehalt + sehr hohe leistungsabhängige Vergütung) wird individuell festgelegt und kann je nach folgenden Faktoren variieren: Motivation, berufsspezifische Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, Ausbildung und Erfahrung. Ihr Leistungsbonus, der während des Projekts in mehreren Tranchen ausgezahlt wird, richtet sich nach Ihrer Leistung und der Erreichung Ihrer Ziele und liegt zwischen 12 und 36 Monatsgehältern pro Projekt. Die leistungsbezogene Vergütung wird durch einen verbindlichen Vertrag mit sehr klaren Zielen/Prämien garantiert. Der Leistungsbonus wird während der Projektdauer in mehreren Stufen ausgezahlt. Zum Beispiel: Nach Erhalt der Baugenehmigung mit den verbesserten Parametern, nach Abschluss der Rohbauarbeiten innerhalb des Budgets und Zeitplans, nach erfolgreicher Fertigstellung. title: AI Product Operations Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p data-section-id="1wdkf9o" data-start="1250" data-end="1267">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands</p> <h2 data-section-id="1wdkf9o" data-start="1250" data-end="1267">About the team</h2> <p data-start="1269" data-end="1487">Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&amp;D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.</p> <p data-start="1489" data-end="1741">AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&amp;D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.</p> <p data-start="1743" data-end="1817">The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.</p> <h2 data-section-id="1wdgaw5" data-start="1846" data-end="1863">About the role</h2> <p data-start="1865" data-end="1976">We're looking for an <strong data-start="1886" data-end="1908">AI Product Operations Lead</strong> to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&amp;D.</p> <p data-start="1978" data-end="2318">This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. You'll help us identify the highest-value problems AI can solve, understand how people work today, design the right solution, build or coordinate its delivery, and then stay accountable for how it performs after launch.</p> <p data-start="2320" data-end="2722">One day, you might be working with a team to understand a frustrating workflow and deciding whether a simple prompt, automation, integration, agent, or internal app is the right answer. The next, you could be improving an existing AI workflow, testing its reliability, helping coordinate access to an enterprise AI tool, or working with IT and InfoSec to make sure a new solution can scale responsibly.</p> <p data-start="2724" data-end="2812">You'll own the connective layer between AI strategy and day-to-day execution across R&amp;D.</p> <p data-start="2814" data-end="3102">This isn't a role for someone who only wants to prototype prompts, manage project plans, or write requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining systems thinking, AI fluency, user discovery, technical execution, and operational ownership—and who wants to see things through.</p> <p data-start="3104" data-end="3320">You'll report to our VP of Product Operations and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, IT, InfoSec, and other AI practitioners across Typeform.<br><br></p> <h2 data-section-id="c1ec1s" data-start="3322" data-end="3339">What you'll do</h2> <ul data-start="3341" data-end="5174"> <li data-section-id="i9zqc3" data-start="3341" data-end="3514">Build and continuously improve our backlog of AI opportunities across R&amp;D, helping teams identify, prioritize, and sequence the jobs where AI can have the greatest impact.</li> <li data-section-id="137d8p0" data-start="3515" data-end="3757">Take ambiguous problems from initial discovery through to delivery: understand the user and workflow, explore options and trade-offs, design the right system, build or coordinate implementation, test, document, launch, measure, and improve.</li> <li data-section-id="13s20b9" data-start="3758" data-end="3971">Design <strong data-start="3767" data-end="3798">simple, AI-native solutions</strong> that fit naturally into how people work. You'll know when a prompt is enough—and when the problem calls for a workflow, integration, agent, database, or custom application.</li> <li data-section-id="jk7adm" data-start="3972" data-end="4155">Help R&amp;D get more value from enterprise AI tools such as Glean and Claude, partnering with IT and InfoSec on areas including access, configuration, connectors, enablement, and support.</li> <li data-section-id="reas7r" data-start="4156" data-end="4286">Own the lifecycle of the AI systems within your portfolio, including automations, skills, agents, and internal web applications.</li> <li data-section-id="js3vfj" data-start="4287" data-end="4455">Establish practical approaches to evaluation, testing, reliability, observability, security, and maintenance—using evidence and feedback to improve systems over time.</li> <li data-section-id="phnp5b" data-start="4456" data-end="4585">Partner with teams across R&amp;D to uncover needs, unblock delivery, clarify ownership, and bring the right experts into the work.</li> <li data-section-id="e4kjhn" data-start="4586" data-end="4737">Help run and evolve our R&amp;D AI governance and enablement practices, giving leaders better visibility into active work, risks, adoption, and outcomes.</li> <li data-section-id="jip211" data-start="4738" data-end="4818">Participate in Typeform's broader AI governance efforts as an R&amp;D contributor.</li> <li data-section-id="19017o3" data-start="4819" data-end="4954">Work with Finance and other partners to improve visibility into AI tool usage, spend, and value, helping inform investment decisions.</li> <li data-section-id="1ssaa0" data-start="4955" data-end="5174">Explore and support the development of autonomous agents that can improve how we plan, discover, design, build, evaluate, and manage work across the product development lifecycle.<br><br></li> </ul> <h2 data-section-id="1phw90b" data-start="5176" data-end="5196">What you'll bring</h2> <ul data-start="5198" data-end="6956"> <li data-section-id="1h4842d" data-start="5198" data-end="5347">Strong practical experience applying AI to real-world problems—not just experimenting with models, but building solutions that people actually use.</li> <li data-section-id="1xnu2gl" data-start="5348" data-end="5476">A track record of taking ambiguous problems from discovery through implementation, testing, adoption, and ongoing improvement.</li> <li data-section-id="vlqdeo" data-start="5477" data-end="5694">Excellent systems thinking. You can understand how people, processes, tools, data flows, integrations, permissions, and technical constraints fit together—and make thoughtful trade-offs between different approaches.</li> <li data-section-id="ynlg00" data-start="5695" data-end="5911">Strong user and workflow discovery skills. You know how to get beyond the initial request, understand the real job to be done, and simplify a solution when the original approach is more complex than it needs to be.</li> <li data-section-id="13bavym" data-start="5912" data-end="6051">Hands-on technical fluency and comfort building, modifying, and troubleshooting internal workflows, automations, agents, or applications.</li> <li data-section-id="b3ajxe" data-start="6052" data-end="6247">Practical experience with modern development practices and tools such as GitHub, repositories and pull requests, basic application hosting, deployment, logging, and operational troubleshooting.</li> <li data-section-id="t57rl" data-start="6248" data-end="6414">Experience managing work independently: prioritizing a backlog, handling dependencies and risks, documenting decisions, and communicating clearly with stakeholders.</li> <li data-section-id="cvqhue" data-start="6415" data-end="6598">A strong approach to evaluation and reliability. You think about what "good" looks like, how to test for it, how to collect feedback, and how to improve a system after it goes live.</li> <li data-section-id="1dbfiqx" data-start="6599" data-end="6822">The ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. You're comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, seeking expert input, and making progress without needing close day-to-day direction.</li> <li data-section-id="p1xali" data-start="6823" data-end="6956">Good judgment around responsible AI, security, access, and governance, and an understanding of when to bring in the right partners.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We <strong>move as one team</strong>, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters <strong>strong bonds</strong> grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We <strong>champion our diverse customer base</strong> by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we<strong> hold high expectations </strong>for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.</p> <p>We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: <p><strong>About Sezzle:</strong></p> <p>With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is <strong>&nbsp;$12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level </strong>per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience</p> <p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p class="p1">We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong> to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.</p> <p class="p1">You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.</p> <p class="p1">Our stack runs on <strong>AWS</strong>, with workloads orchestrated on <strong>Kubernetes</strong> and data anchored in <strong>Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres)</strong>. You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.</p> <p class="p1">Operational ownership is part of the job. You will <strong>participate in the on-call rotation</strong> and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.</p> <p class="p1">You will also build and apply <strong>AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling</strong> for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.</p> <p class="p1">This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure</strong>: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Connect business understanding to improvements across the system</strong>: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Engineer for scale and performance</strong>: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Design and build AWS infrastructure</strong>: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and operate the Kubernetes platform</strong>: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres</strong>: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve reliability through engineering</strong>: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents</strong>: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Implement and test disaster recovery</strong>: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation</strong>: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build observability that makes production diagnosable</strong>: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deliver safe infrastructure migrations</strong>: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes</strong>: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling</strong>: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Make technical decisions clear and executable</strong>: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We look for:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li class="li1">Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)</li> <li class="li1"><strong>12+ years</strong> of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with AWS</strong>: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production</strong>: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with relational databases at scale</strong>, specifically <strong>RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres)</strong>: query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements</strong>: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strong coding and automation skills</strong>, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strong systems fundamentals</strong>: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.</li> <li class="li1">Experience operating a <strong>24/7, high-availability platform</strong> where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation</strong> and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.</li> <li class="li1">Experience implementing and testing <strong>disaster recovery</strong> against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.</li> <li class="li1">Practical experience with <strong>observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices</strong> for shared production infrastructure.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations</strong>, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.</li> <li class="li1">Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1">Experience in <strong>fintech, payments, or banking</strong>, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.</li> <li class="li1">Experience with <strong>multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing</strong>, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.</li> <li class="li1">Proficiency with <strong>Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo</strong>, or comparable observability systems.</li> <li class="li1">Experience building <strong>internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling</strong>, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.</li> <li class="li1">Experience building <strong>AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation</strong> with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points</li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You have relentlessly high standards</strong> - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.</li> <li><strong>You’re not bound by convention</strong> - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things</li> <li><strong>You need action</strong> - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.</li> <li><strong>You earn trust</strong> - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.</li> <li><strong>You have backbone; disagree, then commit </strong>- you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.</li> <li><strong>You deliver results </strong>- you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You go deep</strong>: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You build and ship</strong>: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You measure results</strong>: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You value simplicity</strong>: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You earn trust</strong>: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You stay accountable for the outcome</strong>: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sezzle’s Technology Stack:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Languages:</strong> Golang, Python</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Database:</strong> MySQL, Postgres</li> <li class="li1"><strong>DevOps and Cloud:</strong> AWS, Kubernetes</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Version Control:</strong> Git</li> <li class="li1"><strong>CI/CD:</strong> Gitlab</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Open Source:</strong> Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.</p> <p>#Li-remote #full-time</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

consulting and design engagements.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Position Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Architecture and design of global deployments for Commvault Software and SaaS</li> <li>Design of new solutions and software features to be delivered as a service, new features for existing software</li> <li>Engage with customers to develop an understanding of their data and information management environment from a fresh, pragmatic perspective.</li> <li>Use proven consultative methods to design, implement and/or remediate solutions relating to Modern Data Protection, Multi-Cloud capability,</li> <li>Archive &amp; Compliance, Ransomware/Disaster Recovery, and Operational Improvement.</li> <li>Advise customers on Cyber Recovery, create and agree cyber recovery proposals and create and implement solutions to deliver those proposals</li> <li>Creation of high and low level design documentation for complex Enterprise Architectures</li> <li>Assess customer readiness to determine if all the technical pre-requisites have been met to proceed with the next steps in a project. &nbsp;</li> <li>Perform data migration tasks to transition the customer from the previous backup infrastructure to the new infrastructure.</li> <li>Troubleshooting complex systems in Dev, Test, and production environments</li> <li>Create resolutions and recommendations based on incident investigations to provide greater protection and stability to organizations</li> <li>Lead the diagnosis of complex problems with our products and recommend solutions with minimal oversight</li> description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2>Role Description</h2> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW156930224 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW156930224 BCX0">The AI Security Institute's Research Unit is looking for motivated and talented Software Engineers to join AISI's Core Technology Team. You'll also regularly interact with world-famous researchers and other incredible staff (including alumni from Anthropic, DeepMind, OpenAI, Google, Apple, and professors from Oxford and Cambridge).</p> <h3>About our Core Technology Team</h3> <p style="font-weight: 400;">AISI Core Technology Team comprises several teams building tools and infrastructure used across all of our research work. This includes projects like Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), systems for running evaluations at scale, and hosting frontier open-weights models for evaluations or human studies.</p> <p style="font-weight: 400;">As a software engineer on one of these teams, you might:</p> <ul> <li>Add a feature to one of our “sandbox plugins” for Inspect, supporting advanced agentic evals with safe title: Expression of Interest – Contractor Engagement – Bridge and Structures Inspectors
description: <p><strong>About BakerHicks</strong></p> <p>BakerHicks is a leading design, engineering and project delivery consultancy, delivering complex infrastructure, industrial and built environment projects across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Our Infrastructure team supports a wide range of clients and frameworks, providing specialist engineering, inspection, surveying and asset management services. As our project portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of trusted contractors to support current and future bridge inspection requirements across the UK.</p> <p>Our strength lies in our collaborative approach, technical excellence, and ability to mobilise the right expertise at pace to support our clients’ requirements.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Bridges Team</strong></p> <p>At BakerHicks, our Bridges Team delivers expert engineering solutions across the full lifecycle of bridge and structures projects, from inspection and assessment through to design, refurbishment, strengthening, and replacement works. Our engineers work on a diverse portfolio of assets including highway bridges, railway bridges, footbridges, retaining structures, culverts, and other critical infrastructure across the UK.</p> <p>We combine technical excellence with a practical, collaborative approach, working closely with clients, asset owners, local authorities, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to develop safe, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Our experience spans inspections, structural assessments, repair schemes, asset management programmes, and the delivery of complex infrastructure projects in highly regulated environments.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We are seeking Expressions of Interest from competent and experienced Bridge and Structural Inspectors to join our growing contractor talent pool.</p> <p>This is not a live vacancy tied to a specific project. Instead, we are building a network of pre-qualified professionals who can be considered for assignments as needs arise across our infrastructure portfolio.<br>Applications are welcomed from anywhere in the UK. Site travel will normally be required, there is no requirement to be based near a BakerHicks office.</p> <p>We are particularly keen to hear from inspectors based in Scotland, while welcoming applications from inspectors based in England.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p>We welcome inspectors with experience in one or more of the following activities and environments:</p> <ul> <li>General inspections</li> <li>Principal inspections, including close-up examination and access equipment</li> <li>Safety, special and reactive inspections</li> <li>Inspections for assessment and monitoring</li> <li>Condition surveys (defect investigations and condition scoring)</li> <li>Highway structures on trunk road and local authority networks</li> <li>Railway structures</li> <li>Inspection and access planning, and reporting</li> <li>Team leadership and technical review by appropriately qualified Senior Inspectors</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Relevant asset types and construction forms may include:</p> <ul> <li>Road and rail bridges, including footbridges</li> <li>Culverts and buried structures</li> <li>Retaining walls</li> <li>Tunnel structures</li> <li>Sign and signal gantries, masts and other ancillary highway structures</li> <li>Structures over or adjacent to watercourses, including scour-related inspections</li> <li>Concrete, steel, masonry, timber, composite and post-tensioned structures</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Knowledge &amp; Experience</strong></p> <p>Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following, appropriate to the assignments sought:</p> <ul> <li>Relevant UK bridge or structures inspection experience, with a clear record of inspection roles and asset types</li> <li>Working knowledge of applicable standards and client procedures, including NR/L3/CIV/006 and/or DMRB CS 450 where relevant</li> <li>Ability to identify, photograph and classify defects; record severity and extent; recognise urgent safety issues; and produce accurate reports and recommendations</li> <li>Ability to plan and coordinate inspection works, including access arrangements and traffic or rail control measures.</li> <li>Knowledge of structural materials, deterioration mechanisms, structural behaviour and inspection limitations</li> <li>Experience with National Highways, Transport Scotland, Network Rail, local authorities or comparable asset owners and supply chains</li> <li>Experience producing inspection reports and condition assessments, including reporting using Bridge Condition Indicators</li> <li>IT Literacy – proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Depending on the assignment, the following will be required or advantageous:</p> <ul> <li>Current Bridge Inspector Certification Scheme (BICS) certification at Inspector or Senior Inspector level, appropriate to the work. Required where mandated by the client, including relevant Transport Scotland assignments</li> <li>Relevant BEng/MEng in civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent inspection experience</li> <li>Current working-at-height and confined-space competence, where applicable</li> <li>IPAF/MEWP, IRATA rope-access, PASMA mobile access towers, Ladder or other relevant access qualifications, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe Working Near Water (SWNW) or other equivalent competence, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe use of Trolley Equipment or Rail Trolley controller, where applicable</li> <li>Valid CSCS or other required site-access certification</li> <li>For rail work, current Personal Track Safety (PTS) and other role-specific competences; SSSTS or SMSTS for supervisory duties</li> <li>Network Rail Competencies STE2 – 7 as defined in NR/SP/CTM/017</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why Register Your Interest?</strong></p> <p>By joining our contractor talent pool, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Be considered for assignments matching your competence, location and availability</li> <li>Build a working relationship with BakerHicks</li> <li>Work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals</li> <li>Support projects across a variety of sectors, clients and UK locations</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How to Register Your Interest</strong></p> <p>Please submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will review applications alongside our Infrastructure discipline leaders, and suitable candidates will be invited to an introductory discussion.<br><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Engagement Details</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contract opportunities (Inside IR35 / PAYE engagement)</li> <li>Flexible working depending on project requirements (office/site/hybrid)</li> <li>Locations across the UK</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels.&nbsp;The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements.&nbsp;In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.</em></p> <p><em>Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (</em><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels"><em>National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK</em></a><em>)&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About BakerHicks&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see:&nbsp;<a href="https://bakerhicks.com/en/about">About | BakerHicks</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>BakerHicks. A&nbsp;<a href="https://www.morgansindall.com/">Morgan Sindall Group</a>&nbsp;company.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

With over 500 employees globally and strong backing, we’re scaling fast across new markets and new partner channels.</p> <h4><strong>Who We Are&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>We’re a global team built for speed, trust, and impact. As an AI enabled company, AI is integrated across Threecolts from development through to operations, empowering teams to move faster, build better, improve quality, and make more informed decisions. We hire exceptional people from all backgrounds and give them the autonomy to move fast and the accountability to deliver, where you will wear multiple hats, take ownership of challenges, and proactively solve problems beyond your immediate scope. Change is constant, ambiguity is part of the deal, and clear, concise communication is how we stay aligned, so when in doubt, bring people in.</p></div><p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p> <p><strong>🛠️ What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the growth infrastructure that turns traffic into paying customers across Threecolts’ self-serve products, spanning website, funnel conversion, lifecycle, and performance.</li> <li>This is a senior, hands-on role. Threecolts is deliberately building a lean marketing team that operates at high capacity using AI, which means senior people build as well as lead. You’ll be expected to ship pages, journeys, tests, and improvements directly rather than relying on designers, developers, or large execution teams.</li> <li>You’ll own the website and page production layer, including site architecture, page builds, and extending our component library so new pages can launch in days rather than weeks. This is hands-on build work using templates, pre-built components, and AI tooling, not a role focused on writing briefs and handing execution to someone else.</li> <li>You’ll own conversion across the self-serve funnel, from first session through trial, activation, and paid. You’ll use analytics and behavioural data to understand where the funnel is leaking, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and continuously test and improve performance.</li> <li>Lifecycle also sits within the role. You’ll design and optimise onboarding, activation, retention, and upgrade journeys across a diverse portfolio of products and customer types. Brand owns voice and messaging standards; you own sequencing, triggers, instrumentation, and commercial outcomes.</li> <li>You’ll also own the technical foundations that support growth across marketing, including technical SEO, tracking, campaign infrastructure, and product-led instrumentation within the scope of the role. You’ll work closely with Brand, Product, RevOps, and Engineering to make sure growth activity is measurable and scalable.</li> <li>Depending on experience, you may also manage a small number of direct reports or external specialists.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🎯 What's Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience across Growth, Product-Led Growth, Performance Marketing, Web, or related roles within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital businesses</li> <li>Strong hands-on ability to build and launch landing pages without relying on a designer or developer for day-to-day execution</li> <li>Experience working with modern CMS, component-based page systems, no-code or low-code tooling, and AI-assisted build workflows</li> <li>Strong CRO experience, with a track record of improving conversion across self-serve funnels using analytics, experimentation, and behavioural insight</li> <li>Real product-led growth experience, including trial-to-paid conversion, activation, onboarding, and lifecycle optimisation</li> <li>Strong analytics fluency, with the ability to independently diagnose funnel performance and prioritise opportunities by commercial impact</li> <li>Experience building and optimising lifecycle and email journeys based on behavioural triggers rather than purely campaign-led sends</li> <li>Genuinely hands-on experience using AI tools to build, test, analyse, instrument, and increase execution speed</li> <li>Strong commercial literacy, with a working understanding of CAC, conversion rate, payback, retention, and unit economics</li> <li>Experience operating in fast-paced, lean environments where senior people are expected to execute as well as set direction</li> <li>Strong cross-functional working skills, particularly across Product, Brand, RevOps, Engineering, and Finance</li> </ul> <p><strong>🚀 What We're Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>A hands-on growth operator who is equally comfortable building the infrastructure and improving the numbers that sit on top of it.</li> <li>You think about conversion as a commercial outcome, not a collection of marketing tasks. You can move from identifying a funnel problem in the data to building and shipping the page, journey, or test needed to improve it.</li> <li>You are technically confident enough to work independently. You do not need a designer or developer to ship every change, and you actively use templates, components, automation, and AI to increase your own capacity.</li> <li>You understand product-led growth in practice, particularly the mechanics of turning trial users into activated, paying customers. You see lifecycle as a growth lever rather than simply an email channel.</li> <li>You are commercially minded and comfortable thinking in CAC, conversion, payback, and revenue impact. You can prioritise work based on where it will create the greatest return rather than where there is the loudest internal request.</li> <li>Most importantly, you want ownership of a system rather than ownership of a large team. You are comfortable being in the detail, building alongside others, and creating the infrastructure the rest of marketing depends on.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;💰 Compensation, Perks &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Salary: £ 80,000 per year</li> <li>25 days PTO</li> <li>Healthcare &amp; Pension benefits</li> <li>Opportunity to join company-wide offsites</li> <li>Regular rate reviews and bonus opportunities</li> <li>Fully remote/hybrid working</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

This is an opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s rapidly expanding portfolio, which spans the areas of rare genetic diseases, cardio-metabolic diseases, neuroscience, hematology and hepatology.</p> <p>The successful candidate’s primary role will be to drive the pipeline forward through leadership of clinical development programs.&nbsp; While the primary focus responsibility will be as clinical lead physician on Alnylam’s Huntington’s program, the role may support across a range of therapeutic areas and all stages of development may be required as pipeline assets evolve. The Sr. Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence for associated clinical trials. This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. It is expected that additional opportunities will arise to lead bench-to-bedside early phase clinical development programs.</p> <p>The Senior Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial &amp; QA teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. They will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.</p> <p>This position is hybrid and will be primarily located at our Cambridge, MA headquarters or Maidenhead, UK location.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical programs</li> <li>Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts to secure global regulatory approvals</li> <li>Oversight of trial conduct and safety</li> <li>Provide strategic consultation and guidance to Research on all decisions that have significant clinical components and implications.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs and Commercial to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans</li> <li>Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables</li> <li>Drive/supervise all major written deliverables&nbsp;(regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials</li> <li>Be responsible (as appropriate in line with SOPs) for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, IBs, informed consent forms</li> <li>Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>MD with strong research background or MD PhD, with a track record of successful research support and peer review publications. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.</p> <p>At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. You work with squads on feature work to advise/set direction, and ensure reliability, security, and cost efficiency. Security:</strong> Proven ownership of production service reliability (defining SLIs, incident response) and implementing security practices (access control, secrets management, patching, backup/recovery).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice to have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-Assisted Development:</strong> Comfortable and proficient with AI development tools as part of everyday engineering.</li> <li><strong>Cost Awareness:</strong> Understanding of infrastructure costs and the ability to build cases for spending changes.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration &amp; Adaptability:</strong> Ability to mentor others, foster trust, make pragmatic technology choices, and communicate with "passionate views, loosely held".</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>💰Salary and benefits:</strong></h3> <p>💸£70,000- £76,000 per annum dependent on experience&nbsp;</p> <p>🏖️ 33 days annual leave (Inclusive of bank holidays)</p> <p>🎄 3 gifted days off at Christmas</p> <p>💰 EMI Share Options Scheme</p> <p>🎓 Generous individual learning and training allowance</p> <p>⌚ Truly flexible hours to suit when you work best</p> <p>💻 Full home working set up and beautiful collaborative office space</p> <p>🚗 Free Leeds City Centre office parking</p> <p>🌴 Nomad working policy with family travel insurance</p> <p>🍼 Enhanced 26 weeks maternity and 4 weeks paternity (fully paid)</p> <p>🤍 Health cash plan (from glasses to massages)</p> <p>💸 6% employer pension contribution<strong><br></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>📍Location:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Our beautiful office space in Leeds is our key hub for collaboration, and we love to get together in person. We operate a flexible hybrid working model, including supporting our Genios who are based remotely across the UK. If you are more than 50 miles away from the office, we offer full remote working support within the UK, with the opportunity to join colleagues for in-person collaboration several times a year.</p> <p>We will discuss ways of working with you at interview however if you have any questions before you apply please reach out to <a ---------- <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>💡 What to expect next:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>We’ll review your application and provide a response within 1 week. description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: The Global Tax team is expanding to support Hims & Hers' continued growth across EMEA. We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented tax professional to serve as the tax lead for our EMEA region. The Tax Manager, EMEA will take ownership of all tax provision, compliance, and tax audit matters for the region, working closely with external advisors and local finance/accounting teams and partnering with the U.S.-based corporate tax team on cross-border tax matters. This role will report to the Senior Manager, International Tax. Responsibilities: Manage quarterly and annual tax provisions for the EMEA entities under U.S. GAAP and local statutory standards. Ensure the timely and accurate preparation and submission of corporate income tax and indirect tax filings across multiple EMEA jurisdictions, working closely with accounting/finance teams and external tax advisors. Partner closely with the U.S. tax team, as well as corporate legal and accounting teams, on complex initiatives including entity restructuring, transfer pricing documentation, and permanent establishment (PE) risks analysis. Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across the region and assess business impact. Partner with the global tax team to develop and implement tax-efficient structures for new business and existing operations in EMEA. Effectively communicate status/issues to the Senior Manager, International Tax in the U.S. for all EMEA entities. Perform general EMEA tax research to resolve issues and work with external advisers where needed to support business initiatives. Maintain accurate and up-to-date tax compliance calendars and documentation, ensuring robust control and risk management. Develop tax staff by managing performance, setting goals, providing ongoing training, and maintaining strong employee relationships. Experience & Skills: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or tax required. At least 5 years’ experience in corporate tax gained within a multinational organisation or Big 4/public accounting environment. Professional qualification in Tax, Accounting, or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA) preferred. Strong technical knowledge of EMEA direct and indirect tax rules, reporting obligations and tax accounting standards. Experience with US GAAP tax provision preparation and review (ASC 740) preferred. Familiarity with transfer pricing principles and international tax frameworks (e.g., BEPS, Pillar Two). Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with the U.S.-based tax team across time zones. Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment. We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. As a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager supporting our EMEA organization, you'll operate as a true strategic thought partner to Sales and Post-sales leadership, helping design and build the enablement infrastructure needed to win in complex sales environments. This is a high-autonomy role that shapes how Vanta's revenue teams learn, grow, and perform. This role will lead the execution of both global enablement initiatives and region-specific programs. You’ll work independently, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and help EMEA leaders reinforce new skills and behaviors with their teams. What you’ll do as a Senior Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta: Partner closely with EMEA Revenue Leadership to understand business priorities, team performance, and enablement needs. Build trusted relationships with sales leadership and cross-functional partners across Revenue and the broader business. Diagnose gaps in industry, product, sales methodology, and role-specific skills across EMEA. Design and prioritize a regional enablement roadmap that connects global initiatives to the needs of EMEA teams. Support regional onboarding where needed. Create and deliver enablement programs, content, workshops, and other learning experiences that improve sales execution. Partner with EMEA leaders to reinforce enablement in the field and hold teams accountable for applying new knowledge and skills. Measure program effectiveness, gather feedback, and refine enablement priorities as the business, product, and sales motion evolve. Collaborate with other Revenue Enablement partners to maintain alignment across global programs and regional delivery. How to be successful in this role: 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, GTM enablement, or an equivalent role. Experience supporting EMEA-specific sales teams and markets. Experience supporting global sales organizations in a variety of roles spanning Early Stage through Upmarket segments. A track record of designing and delivering sales methodology enablement. Experience in SaaS; experience supporting a technical product is preferred. Strong ability to diagnose capability gaps and translate them into focused enablement priorities. Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across varied audiences. Strong business partnership and cross-functional collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and build credibility with senior sales leaders. Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar. Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
